meta.notes: A banner_pattern tag gives one name to several banner_pattern ids. values lists ids or other tags (written #namespace:path); set replace to true only to wipe what other packs put in a tag of the same id. A banner pattern item's minecraft:provides_banner_patterns component names a tag like #msm_examples:borders, and the loom then offers its patterns; vanilla's minecraft:no_item_required lists the patterns the loom offers without one.
